entity.name: Pléiades satellite imagery (CNES 2017, Distribution Airbus DS)

lineage.description: Pléiades satellite imagery from 26 October 2017 was acquired and processed by REACH to delineate the spatial extent and structure of Kutupalong makeshift settlements and expansion zones. The imagery was converted to KMZ format to enable visualization and field-based analysis through multiple geospatial platforms including Google Earth, OSM Navigator, and GPS units.
